user.title: Connect to T3 Code
user.description: Connect to an existing T3 Code server. Paste its /pair#token=... link, or enter the server URL and a pairing token. For a token issued by t3 auth session issue, select Bearer token. The address must be reachable from Home Assistant.

data.url: T3 server URL or pairing link

reauth_confirm.title: Connect to T3 Code
reauth_confirm.description: The T3 session expired or was revoked. Enter a new pairing link/token or bearer token for the same server.

data.url: T3 server URL or pairing link

reconfigure.title: Connect to T3 Code
reconfigure.description: Update the address or credential for this T3 server. Supply a new pairing link/token or bearer token; the server identity must match.

data.url: T3 server URL or pairing link

error.invalid_connection: Enter an http(s) server URL or a /pair#token=... link and a credential.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Use a fresh pairing token or a valid bearer token with orchestration:read and diagnostics:read permissions.
error.cannot_connect: Could not read T3 metrics. Check that Home Assistant can reach the server and retry. If pairing succeeded, this form will reuse that session.
error.unsupported_server: The server returned an unsupported protocol or usage response. This integration supports T3 orchestration protocols 1–2 and usage contracts 4–6.

abort.already_configured: This T3 server is already configured.
abort.wrong_server: This is a different T3 server. Add it as a new integration.
